author.name: FLUX team
author.role: Blueprint written as JSON, no code

lines: The whole flat just went dark.
The charger worked perfectly at 6 PM.

bet.q: A new 32 A car charger keeps tripping the flat's main breaker. When does it happen?

options.label: The moment it is plugged in
At 3 AM, when the battery is nearly full

explain: The charger draws the same 32 A all evening. The house does not.
At 7 PM the AC pushes the flat close to the 40 A main breaker. At 8:30 the induction cooktop joins in, and the total crosses it.
The fix is not a bigger main breaker. It is either a smaller fixed charger current, or a charger that measures the house and backs off.

missions.title: Sabotage #1
missions.goal: Black out the flat. You may not touch the charger.
missions.hint: The charger is locked at 32 A. Drag the clock into the evening and watch the house load.
missions.win: Dinner + AC + car crossed the main breaker.

missions.title: Sabotage #2
missions.goal: No load balancing. Find the HIGHEST fixed charger setting that survives the whole evening, then run the evening.
missions.hint: Find the worst moment (AC + cooking) and leave the car only what fits under the main breaker.
missions.win: The highest setting that never crosses the main breaker.

missions.title: Fix it properly
missions.goal: Keep the charger set to 32 A and charge THROUGH dinner without tripping.
missions.hint: Switch on load balancing. The charger measures the house and takes only what is left.
missions.win: The car slowed down during dinner instead of the flat going dark.
missions.when: balance == 1 && cookOn == 1 && evA > 0 && total <= mainLimit && charger == 32

rule.q: The 32 A charger gets its own circuit. Which breaker do you fit?

options.why: Sized at exactly the load. A charger draws full current for hours, so common practice sizes the circuit for 125% of it.
32 × 1.25 = 40 A, with a cable rated for 40 A (often 6 mm² copper on a short run; check the cable table for how it is laid).
Too big for the cable. The cable could overheat long before a 63 A breaker trips.

rule.explain: Two rules: the whole house must fit under the main breaker at its busiest moment, and a charger's own circuit is sized for 125% of its continuous current.

ask.label: Highest fixed charger setting that never trips the main
With load balancing (2 A margin), what does the car get at dinner?
ask.expr: min(32, floor(mainLimit - (base + ac + cook) * 1000 / V - margin))

work.valid: floor(mainLimit - (base + ac + cook) * 1000 / V - margin) >= minEv
work.story: 230 V single-phase flat. Charger can be set from 6 A to 32 A. All the loads below can run at the same time at dinner.

tests.name: AC evening runs near the limit
